Jane Doe
jane.doe@example.com · +1 555 0100 · Berlin
SUMMARY
Backend engineer with 6 years of experience building data platforms.
EXPERIENCE
Senior Backend Engineer — Acme Corp, Berlin Mar 2021 – Present

Software Engineer — Globex, Munich Jan 2018 – Jun 2020

PROJECTS
Open-source rate limiter (Go, Redis) — token bucket library with 1.2k GitHub stars
SKILLS
Languages: Python, Go, SQL
Cloud: AWS, Kubernetes, Terraform
EDUCATION
TU Munich — MSc Computer Science, 2016 – 2018
